title: 第13章 追逐与胜利第14章 女王
slug: 性转狐狸开局就被抓走了
content_zh:
圣女把兽核小心地收进一个小巧的袋子里，然后轻轻地挂在艾可的脖子上。
“我再给你这个。”她把一块小巧的石子放在艾可的爪子上，石子散发着温暖的气息，微微闪烁着柔和的光芒。
艾可歪着小脑袋，满心的疑惑。她根本不知道这是一块什么样的石头，但她心里想着，如果能有几百块这样的石头，那就能在自己的洞穴里铺出一层舒适的地面了。
“这块灵石能让你修炼得更快，不过对你来说，它只是为你聚集周围的能量供你使用。”她耐心地解释道。“它也会为了我的研究目的追踪你的位置，我就不信搞不清楚这奇怪的状况！”她和善地对着艾可笑了笑，笑容里充满了期待和好奇。
艾可接过那温暖的石头，满心欢喜，在仙子的帮助下，小心翼翼地把它放进了袋子里。
圣女的眼神突然变得凌厉起来。“你快跑，更多人来了。”她急切地警告这只小野兽。
圣女的话音刚落，艾可就连忙点头，毫不犹豫地转身跑开了。她的耐力此时已经所剩无几，根本无法全力施展自己的能力，但稍微用一点[暗影行走]还是可以做到的。
……
“圣女。”那女子拱手行礼，但声音里丝毫没有敬意，只有深深的恶毒，仿佛隐藏着无数的阴谋。“真没想到你能和一只野兽契约。”她摇了摇头，脸上满是不屑，同时示意她的小跟班去追赶那只小野兽。
“我也没想到你会和魔门勾结。”圣女无奈地摇了摇头，眼神中透露出一丝失望和愤怒。
“勾结？”她放肆地哈哈大笑起来。“这只是看法不同罢了，他们给了我们门派没有的修炼资源，只想要一点情报。不管怎么看，这和我们门派的公告没什么两样。”她对着这个被她视为愚蠢的圣女再次摇了摇头，脸上满是嘲讽和轻视。
‘你这么说，不过是因为嫉妒我和师兄一起修炼。’圣女深深地叹了口气，她心里很清楚，师姐爱慕着和自己一起修炼的师兄，但师兄并不喜欢师姐，于是师姐便把所有的怨恨和不满都发泄在了她的身上。
通常来说，她并不是师姐的对手，但她们自愿走进这片森林，这让一切都变得容易多了。她顿时热血沸腾，头顶上一只冰凤凰的雕像发出了愤怒的咆哮声，仿佛在宣告着战斗的开始。
……
艾可在黑暗中拼命地奔跑着。她敏锐地感觉到身后的危险正在步步逼近，所以不敢有丝毫的放慢速度，甚至不敢回头看上一眼。她只能依靠自己敏锐的感觉和黑暗的掩护来摆脱眼前的困境。她这次的收获总体来说……相当不错，不，应该说是非常好。那一块肉就让她的等级迅速升到了36级，让她的速度稳定在筑基八阶的中层水平。如果能够使用冲刺技能，她轻易就能超越九阶的速度。
*嗖*
凭借着敏锐的直觉，她惊险地躲开了一支从身边呼啸而过的箭。在这片略显稀疏的森林里拖着追兵可不是什么明智的主意，她必须赶紧跑进那茂密的丛林深处，才有机会甩掉他们。
*嗖*
又一支箭从她的身边惊险地擦过。这支箭比上一支更近了，那凌厉的风声让她脊背发凉。她绝对不能被这支箭射中，不然以她那少得可怜的生命值，肯定会当场丧命！
“追！就在前面！”侦察兵对着他的同伴大声喊道，声音中充满了急切和兴奋。

“抓住它！别让它跑了！”另一个眼睛歪斜的人扯着嗓子喊道，那狰狞的表情仿佛要将艾可生吞活剥。
“为了圣女！”最后一个一脸陶醉的家伙声嘶力竭地喊道，那狂热的模样让人不寒而栗。
他们在后面疯狂地追赶着她，但看起来速度并不比她快多少。不过，也有可能他们只是想把她累得精疲力竭，然后再轻松地抓住她，这可不是什么好兆头。她不想死，也不想被抓住。虽然她也曾有过一瞬间的想法，要是能当一只宠物，每天都能吃到超级美味的东西……但她也很快意识到他们肯定会让她做一些她不一定喜欢的事情。
她纵身一跃，跳到另一棵树后面，一支箭紧接着飞了过去。从射箭的频率来看，这个弓箭手应该只有为数不多的几支箭，而且他正在忙着回收射出的箭，所以他必须避开路上的石头和树木。这也可能意味着箭头被涂上了某种可怕的东西。
他们神志不清地谈论着“圣女”会怎么踩他们、鞭打他们。这让她感到无比的恶心，但因为她不会说话，根本没法让他们闭嘴。
……
“该死……你怎么还有这么多力气。”“圣女”狠狠地吐了一口鲜血，脸色苍白如纸。
“师姐，你只是选错了目标。”圣女轻轻摇了摇头，眼神中充满了怜悯。
她的血脉，如果运用得当，可以有效地压制敌人的内力，降低他们的修为和可用的真气。修为更高的师姐也不例外，因为她愚蠢地走进了这片森林。森林会将人类修士的修为压制在筑基巅峰。金丹和元婴修士有一些特殊的手段，所以他们的整体实力不会下降太多。这位师姐原本是金丹巅峰，但听到森林里凤凰的叫声后，一路掉到了筑基中下层。
“师姐，你就在坟墓里后悔你的决定吧。”圣女轻声说道，语气中带着一丝决绝。
假圣女疯狂地大笑起来。“你知道吗，那些人的箭上都涂了剧毒？哪怕只是轻轻碰一下你的野兽，都会让它痛苦不堪！”她像个疯子一样笑着。“而且我们都知道你不会选择普通契约来和野兽绑定！换句话说，你会和你的野兽一样受苦！慢慢地被毒药腐蚀，在痛苦中——啊啊啊啊啊。”她得意地笑着，直到圣女用一种特殊的[武技]瞬间砍掉了她的胳膊和腿，留下了一个“V”字形的深深剑伤。
这意味着如果她练习得足够多，就能同时砍掉别人的胳膊和腿，就像刚刚发生的那样。而且，她对这一招已经非常熟练，能够在上面注入她的冰焰，灼烧伤口，让敌人无法轻易死去。
假圣女发出了凄厉的惨叫声，被她慢慢地肢解。
“你怎么做都不重要。”圣女摇了摇头，表情冷漠。“重要的是，你们都得死！”
假圣女在癫狂中喘着粗气，依然疯狂地笑着。“哈哈哈哈，你以为我们追踪不到你的野兽！？我们都知道你忍不住会给人追踪灵石。你肯定也给她了一个，对吧？”她看到圣女脸上奇怪的表情，又得意地笑了起来。“我们能通过破解的微弱信号追踪到她！没有地方能躲开我们！”
content_en:
The saint carefully put the beast core into a small bag, and then hung it gently around Echo's neck.
"I'll give you this again." She put a small stone on Aiko's paw. The stone exuded a warm atmosphere and shone softly.
Ai Ke tilted his little head, full of doubts. She had no idea what kind of stone it was, but she thought that if she could have hundreds of such stones, she could create a comfortable floor in her cave.
"This spirit stone will allow you to practice faster, but for you, it just gathers the energy around you for you to use." She explained patiently. "It will also track your location for my research purposes. I can't believe it can't figure out this strange situation!" She smiled kindly at Aike, her smile full of expectation and curiosity.
Ai Ke took the warm stone, full of joy, and carefully put it into the bag with the help of the fairy.
The saint's eyes suddenly became sharp. "Run quickly, more people are coming." She warned the little beast eagerly.
As soon as the saint finished speaking, Aike nodded quickly, turned around and ran away without hesitation. She had very little endurance left at this time, and she couldn't fully use her abilities, but she could still do it with a little [Shadow Walking].
…
"Saint." The woman saluted with her hands raised, but there was no respect at all in her voice, only deep malice, as if she was hiding countless conspiracies. "I never thought you could make a contract with a beast." She shook her head, her face full of disdain, and motioned to her little follower to chase the little beast.
"I didn't expect you to collude with the Demon Sect." The saint shook her head helplessly, with a hint of disappointment and anger in her eyes.
"Collusion?" She laughed wildly. "It's just a difference of opinion. They gave us training resources that our sect doesn't have, and they just want a little information. No matter how you look at it, this is no different from our sect's announcement." She shook her head again at this saint whom she regarded as stupid, her face full of ridicule and contempt.
‘You just say that because you are jealous that I am practicing with my senior brother. ’ The saint sighed deeply. She knew very well that the senior sister loved the senior brother who practiced with her, but the senior brother did not like the senior sister, so the senior sister vented all her resentment and dissatisfaction on her.
Normally, she was no match for her senior sister, but they walked into this forest voluntarily, which made everything much easier. Her blood suddenly boiled, and the statue of an ice phoenix above her head roared angrily, as if announcing the beginning of the battle.
…
Echo ran desperately in the darkness. She keenly felt that the danger behind her was approaching step by step, so she did not dare to slow down at all, or even look back. She could only rely on her keen senses and the cover of darkness to get out of the immediate predicament. Overall, her harvest this time was... quite good, no, it should be said to be very good. That piece of meat quickly raised her level to level 36, stabilizing her speed at the middle level of the eighth level of foundation building. If she could use the sprinting skill, she could easily surpass the ninth level of speed.
*whoosh*
With her keen intuition, she narrowly dodged an arrow whizzing past her. It was not a wise idea to drag the pursuers in this slightly sparse forest. She had to run deep into the dense jungle to have a chance to get rid of them.
*whoosh*
Another arrow narrowly missed her. This arrow was closer than the previous one, and the sharp sound of the wind sent shivers down her spine. She must not be hit by this arrow, otherwise with her pitiful health, she will definitely die on the spot!
"Chase! Just ahead!" the scout shouted to his companions, his voice full of eagerness and excitement."Catch it! Don't let it escape!" Another man with crooked eyes shouted at the top of his voice, with a ferocious expression as if he wanted to eat Aiko alive.
"For the Saint!" The last guy with an intoxicated face yelled at the top of his lungs, and his enthusiastic look made people shudder.
They were chasing her frantically, but they didn't seem to be much faster than she was. However, it's also possible that they just wanted to tire her out and catch her easily, which wouldn't be a good sign. She didn't want to die, and she didn't want to be caught. Although she had briefly thought that if she could be a pet, she could eat super delicious things every day... but she also quickly realized that they would definitely make her do some things that she might not necessarily like.
She jumped behind another tree, and an arrow flew past. Judging from the frequency of shooting, this archer should only have a few arrows, and he is busy recovering the arrows, so he must avoid stones and trees on the road. It could also mean that the arrow is painted with something scary.
They talked deliriously about how the "saint" would step on them and whip them. This made her feel extremely sick, but since she couldn't speak, there was no way she could shut them up.
…
"Damn it...how do you still have so much strength?" "Saint Girl" spit out a mouthful of blood, her face as pale as paper.
"Sister, you just chose the wrong target." The saint shook her head gently, her eyes full of pity.
Her bloodline, if used properly, can effectively suppress the enemy's internal strength, reducing their cultivation and available Qi. The senior sister with higher cultivation level was no exception, because she foolishly walked into this forest. The forest will suppress the cultivation of human monks at the peak of foundation building. Jindan and Yuanying monks have some special methods, so their overall strength will not drop too much. This senior sister was originally at the peak of the Golden Core, but after hearing the cry of the phoenix in the forest, she fell all the way to the middle and lower levels of the foundation.
"Sister, you can regret your decision in your grave." The saint said softly, with a hint of determination in her tone.
The fake saint laughed wildly. "Did you know that those people's arrows are coated with poison? Even just touching your beast will cause it to suffer terribly!" She smiled like a madman. "And we all know that you will not choose an ordinary contract to be bound to the beast! In other words, you will suffer the same as your beast! Slowly corroded by the poison, in pain - ahhhhhh." She smiled proudly until the saint used a special [martial skill] to instantly chop off her arms and legs, leaving a deep "V" shaped sword wound.
This means that if she practices enough, she can chop off someone's arms and legs at the same time, like what just happened. Moreover, she has become very proficient in this move, and can inject her ice flames on it to burn the wounds so that the enemy cannot die easily.
The fake saint let out a shrill scream and was slowly dismembered by her.
"It doesn't matter what you do." The saint shook her head with a cold expression. "The important thing is that you all have to die!"
The fake saint was panting heavily in her madness, still smiling crazily. "Hahahaha, you think we can't track your beast!? We all know that you can't help but give people tracking spiritual stones. You must have given her one too, right?" She saw the strange expression on the saint's face and smiled proudly again. "We can track her by cracking the weak signal! There's no hiding from us!"
